adoption.instructions: Should the proposed EXP-001 contract be accepted now, accepted with explicit edits, or rejected? Select the scientifically sound next step before any Blender execution.
criteria: Accept with explicit edits: primary A/B-geo/B-mat/C/D, separate E CPU visibility and F historical baseline as secondary controls, state geometry-only two coordinated edits and object readback, retain fixed numerical thresholds and no Blender until resources allow; publish the closed pre-Blender contract without calling it physical validation.
Accept exactly as written and declare the CPU exploratory results confirmatory physical Blender results.
Reject all controls and build a larger mesh before testing the cell.

tolerance_and_gate.instructions: Choose how to handle proposed 1e-9 Blender dark-port tolerance and float32 estimate when actual Blender object transforms have not been measured.
criteria: Freeze 1e-9 as a preregistered acceptance threshold (and 1e-12 CPU), require actual save/reopen object readback and report any failure without changing thresholds; keep experiment blocked until resource gate and final review.
Retune the threshold after observing Blender results so the experiment passes.
Call the float32 emulation a Blender execution and remove the runtime gate.
